chapterInfo.content:
2
Mose awoɔ
1 # Eks 6.20 Na ɔbarima bi a ɔfiri Lewi fie kɔwaree Lewi babaa bi. 2#Aso 7.20; Heb 11.23 Na ɔbaa no nyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabanin; na ɔhunuu sɛ ne ho yɛ fɛ no, ɔde no siee abosome mmiɛnsa.
3Na ɔntumi nkora no bio no, ɔfaa mmɛwa adaka bi de ama ne ɛhyɛ sraa ho, na ɔde abɔfra no too mu, na ɔde kɔsii wira mu wɔ asuo no ano. 4#Eks 15.20 Na ne nuabaa kɔgyinaa akyirikyiri sɛ ɔrehwɛ deɛ ɛbɛyɛ no.
5Na Farao babaa siane baa asuo no ano adwareɛ, na ne mmaawa repasa asuo no nsunoa. Berɛ a Farao babaa hunuu adaka no wɔ wira no mu no, ɔsomaa n’abaawa sɛ ɔnkɔfa mmra. 6Na ɔbuee soɔ no, ɔhunuu akɔkoaa no, na hwɛ, na ɔyɛ abarimaa a ɔresu. Na ɔyɛɛ no mmɔbɔ, na ɔse: Hebrifoɔ mma no bi nie. 7Ɛnna ne nuabaa no ka kyerɛɛ Farao babaa no sɛ: Menkɔ menkɔfrɛ Hebrifoɔ mmaa no mu nufomafoɔ bi memmrɛ wo, na ɔmmɛma akɔkoaa no nufoɔ mma wo anaa? 8Na Farao babaa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ! Na ababaa no kɔ kɔfrɛɛ abɔfra no na bae. 9Na Farao babaa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa abɔfra yi kɔ kɔma no nufoɔ ma me, na mɛtua wo ka. Na ɔbaa no faa abɔfra no kɔmaa no nufoɔ. 10Na abɔfra no nyinii, na ɔde no kɔmaa Farao babaa no, na ɔdanee ne ba. Na ɔtoo no din Mose, ɛfiri sɛ ɔse: Nsuo mu na meyii no firiiɛ.
Mose dwane kɔ Midian
11 # Heb 11.24-25 Na Mose nyiniiɛ no, da bi ɔfirii adi kɔɔ ne nuanom nkyɛn sɛ ɔrekɔhwɛ wɔn adwumayɛ no; na ɔhunuu sɛ Misraimni bi reboro ne nuanom mu bi a ɔyɛ Hebrini. 12#Aso 7.24 Na ɔhwɛɛ ha ne ha, na ɔhunuu sɛ obiara nni hɔ no, ɔbɔɔ Misraimni no kumm no, na ɔde no siee anwea mu. 13Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, ɔfirii adi, na hwɛ, na Hebrifoɔ baanu reko. Na ɔbisaa deɛ ɔdi fɔ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na woboro wo yɔnko? 14#Aso 7.27-28, 35 Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Hwan na ɔde wo sii yɛn so otitire ne osennifoɔ? Wopɛ sɛ woku me sɛdeɛ wokum Misraimni no anaa? Na Mose suroe, na ɔse: Ampa ara, asɛm no apue!
15 # Heb 11.27 Na Farao tee asɛm yi no, anka ɔrehwehwɛ Mose aku no, nanso Mose dwane firii n’anim kɔtenaa Midian asase so wɔ subura bi ho. 16#Eks 3.1 Nso na Midian sɔfoɔ wɔ mmammaa baason; na wɔba bɛtoo nsuo de hyehyɛɛ adaaseɛ no amaama sɛ wɔrema wɔn agya nnwan anom. 17#Gye 29.10 Na nnwanhwɛfoɔ bi ba bɛpamm wɔn; na Mose sɔre boaa wɔn, na ɔmaa wɔn nnwan no nomee. 18Na wɔbaa wɔn agya Reuel nkyɛn no, ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na ɛnnɛ deɛ, moaba ntɛm seyie? 19Na wɔbuaa sɛ: Misraimni bi na ɔgyee yɛn firii nnwanhwɛfoɔ no nsam, na ɔtoo nsuo mpo maa yɛn, na ɔmaa nnwan no nomee. 20Na ɔbisaa ne mmammaa no sɛ: Na ɔwɔ he? Adɛn nti na mogyaa ɔbarima no hɔ? Monkɔfrɛ no na ɔmmɛdidi.
21Na Mose penee sɛ ɔne Midian sɔfoɔ no bɛtena. Na ɔde ne babaa Sipora maa Mose awareɛ.
22 # Eks 18.3 Na ɔwoo ɔbabanin, na Mose too no din Gersom,#2.22 GERSOM: Asekyerɛ ne: Baabi hɔhoɔ. ɛfiri sɛ ɔse: Mayɛ hɔhoɔ wɔ ananafoɔ asase so.
23 # Eks 3.7 Na nna dodoɔ yi akyiri no, ɛbaa sɛ Misraimhene wui. Na nkoasom no nti Israelfoɔ no sii apini, na wɔsu frɛe, na wɔn sufrɛ no kɔduruu Nyankopɔn anim. 24#Gye 15.18; 26.3; 28.13-14 Na Onyankopɔn tee wɔn apinisie no, ɔkaee n’apam a ɔne Abraham ne Isak ne Yakob pameeɛ no. 25Na Onyankopɔn hwɛɛ Israelfoɔ no, ɔhunuu wɔn tebea a wɔwɔ mu no.

Na ɔbarima bi a ɔfiri Lewi fie kɔwaree Lewi babaa bi. Na ɔbaa no nyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabanin; na ɔhunuu sɛ ne ho yɛ fɛ no, ɔde no siee abosome mmiɛnsa.
Na ɔntumi nkora no bio no, ɔfaa mmɛwa adaka bi de ama ne ɛhyɛ sraa ho, na ɔde abɔfra no too mu, na ɔde kɔsii wira mu wɔ asuo no ano. Na ne nuabaa kɔgyinaa akyirikyiri sɛ ɔrehwɛ deɛ ɛbɛyɛ no.

Ɛnna ne nuabaa no ka kyerɛɛ Farao babaa no sɛ: Menkɔ menkɔfrɛ Hebrifoɔ mmaa no mu nufomafoɔ bi memmrɛ wo, na ɔmmɛma akɔkoaa no nufoɔ mma wo anaa? Na Farao babaa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ! Na ababaa no kɔ kɔfrɛɛ abɔfra no na bae. Na Farao babaa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa abɔfra yi kɔ kɔma no nufoɔ ma me, na mɛtua wo ka. Na ɔbaa no faa abɔfra no kɔmaa no nufoɔ. Na abɔfra no nyinii, na ɔde no kɔmaa Farao babaa no, na ɔdanee ne ba. Na ɔtoo no din Mose, ɛfiri sɛ ɔse: Nsuo mu na meyii no firiiɛ.

Na Mose nyiniiɛ no, da bi ɔfirii adi kɔɔ ne nuanom nkyɛn sɛ ɔrekɔhwɛ wɔn adwumayɛ no; na ɔhunuu sɛ Misraimni bi reboro ne nuanom mu bi a ɔyɛ Hebrini. Na ɔhwɛɛ ha ne ha, na ɔhunuu sɛ obiara nni hɔ no, ɔbɔɔ Misraimni no kumm no, na ɔde no siee anwea mu. Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, ɔfirii adi, na hwɛ, na Hebrifoɔ baanu reko. Na ɔbisaa deɛ ɔdi fɔ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na woboro wo yɔnko? Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Hwan na ɔde wo sii yɛn so otitire ne osennifoɔ? Wopɛ sɛ woku me sɛdeɛ wokum Misraimni no anaa? Na Mose suroe, na ɔse: Ampa ara, asɛm no apue!
Na Farao tee asɛm yi no, anka ɔrehwehwɛ Mose aku no, nanso Mose dwane firii n’anim kɔtenaa Midian asase so wɔ subura bi ho. Nso na Midian sɔfoɔ wɔ mmammaa baason; na wɔba bɛtoo nsuo de hyehyɛɛ adaaseɛ no amaama sɛ wɔrema wɔn agya nnwan anom. Na nnwanhwɛfoɔ bi ba bɛpamm wɔn; na Mose sɔre boaa wɔn, na ɔmaa wɔn nnwan no nomee. Na wɔbaa wɔn agya Reuel nkyɛn no, ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na ɛnnɛ deɛ, moaba ntɛm seyie? Monkɔfrɛ no na ɔmmɛdidi.
Na Mose penee sɛ ɔne Midian sɔfoɔ no bɛtena. Na ɔde ne babaa Sipora maa Mose awareɛ.
Na ɔwoo ɔbabanin, na Mose too no din Gersom, ɛfiri sɛ ɔse: Mayɛ hɔhoɔ wɔ ananafoɔ asase so.
Na nna dodoɔ yi akyiri no, ɛbaa sɛ Misraimhene wui. Na nkoasom no nti Israelfoɔ no sii apini, na wɔsu frɛe, na wɔn sufrɛ no kɔduruu Nyankopɔn anim. Na Onyankopɔn tee wɔn apinisie no, ɔkaee n’apam a ɔne Abraham ne Isak ne Yakob pameeɛ no. Na Onyankopɔn hwɛɛ Israelfoɔ no, ɔhunuu wɔn tebea a wɔwɔ mu no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
